notes.title: Version 1.1 released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The update version 1.1 will be released on April 26 (UTC / GMT + 08:00) (possibly ahead of schedule)

This is the first update since the release of the game. This update is just a minor repair to the basic functions of the game. We expect to release the first major update of the game next month. This update will greatly improve the playability of the game. Please look forward to it!

After looking forward to the future, it's time for us to talk about the present.

In this update, you can choose to join or not join the global leaderboard. The global leaderboard includes global high score leaderboard and global real-time leaderboard. We will introduce the mechanism of the new leaderboard in detail below.

[h3]1. Global high score ranking[/h3]

Global high score ranking, as the name suggests, is the highest score ranking in the world. Every time you break your own limit, you will get a chance to enter the ranking! Please try to break through your limit!

[h3]2. Global real time rankings[/h3]

The global real-time ranking, in the same way, is the ranking that all players around the world play the game. Every time you play the game, you will get a chance to enter the ranking! Whether you score 0 or 10000, it's the same! Every time your score will refresh your position in the leaderboard, please keep your level in every game and maintain your position!

In addition to the leaderboard mechanism, we also placed the networking button in the lower left corner of the game. When you access our server, the icon in the lower left corner will turn into color, otherwise, it will turn into black and white. When the icon turns black and white, you will not be in the global leaderboard.

We also optimize the game code, which will reduce your false touches in the game and improve the game experience.

This is the whole content of this update, I hope you like it!

Number game: 24 o'clock development team
